description: Fidelity-sensitive memory corpus: multi-clause statements with exact numbers, causal links, names, and dates. Designed to measure whether a memory layer preserves what was actually said. Every statement is synthetic: the people, companies, products, places and figures are made up.

items.content: Priya switched the Tidewatch price alerts from SMS to email digests on March 3, 2026 because the SMS gateway throttled the bot at 20 messages per minute during earnings season.
items.probe: why did the Tidewatch alerts move off SMS?

items.content: The paper-trading breakout strategy on the ZX index future uses a 4 point stop loss and a 12 point target, and it only enters when the 10 period average crosses the 30 period average on the 5 minute chart.
items.probe: what are the stop and target for the breakout strategy?

items.content: Simulation run a7c204 failed the release gate because its profit factor was 1.12, below the 1.25 minimum, even though 57 percent of its trades were winners.
items.probe: why did simulation a7c204 fail the gate?

items.content: Ledgerline applies a 12 percent sales tax to standard items, but prepared meals use a reduced 6 percent rate under the Riverton Hospitality Code.
items.probe: what tax rate does Ledgerline apply to prepared meals?

items.content: Riverton payroll levies take 4 percent from employers on wages above the 48,500 credit annual threshold, and employees pay nothing toward them.
items.probe: who pays the Riverton payroll levy and how much?

items.content: The import wizard posts opening balances to account 3900 Opening Balance Equity rather than restating revenue, because restating would double count sales tax that was already filed.
items.probe: which account do opening balances post to and why?

items.content: The shared build runner has a 3 GB memory cap, so the load-test and data-seeding scripts were added to the Docker ignore list after they stalled builds with out-of-memory errors that a 32 GB laptop had hidden.
items.probe: why were the load-test scripts added to the Docker ignore list?

items.content: The demo environment runs on a single 2 GB container with a hard limit of 150 concurrent requests, and its SQLite file sits on one persistent volume.
items.probe: what are the resource limits of the demo container?

items.content: The job monitor sends an email titled Nightly Export ALERT only after a scheduled export misses two consecutive runs, because single misses caused false alarms every 40 minutes.
items.probe: when does the job monitor send an alert email?

items.content: Version 5 of the charting script language defaults the margin setting to 0 instead of 100, which silently produces empty backtest reports until the margin is set back to 100 percent.
items.probe: why were the version 5 backtest reports empty?

items.content: The video export must render at the native 50 fps of the animation timeline, because rendering at 25 fps keeps the same duration but looks choppy, which Tomas described as seeming sped up.
items.probe: what frame rate should the video export use and why?

items.content: The embedding provider rejects inputs longer than 8192 tokens, so the ingest service trims embedding input to 24000 characters before any provider call.
items.probe: what is the embedding input limit and how is it handled?

items.content: In the Monday planning call, Keiko agreed to deliver the billing migration guide by May 12, 2026, while Luis owns the webhook signature check that blocked 4 customers last week.
items.probe: who owns the billing migration guide and when is it due?

items.content: The partner call moved from 11 am to 3:15 pm Central on Wednesday because the lead reviewer is flying back from a conference in Oslo that morning.
items.probe: what time is the partner call now?

items.content: Dana wants release status reported in three explicit states: merged, deployed to staging, or live in production, because the word done once hid an undeployed fix for 9 days.
items.probe: how does Dana want release status reported?

items.content: Dana drinks espresso before 9 am but switches to herbal tea after lunch, because caffeine after 1 pm lowers the sleep score on her tracker, which fell to 64 last month.
items.probe: what does Dana drink in the afternoon and why?

items.content: The Marrow Bay flood of April 9, 1911 covered about one third of the old harbor district, and the survivors rebuilt the market 2 kilometers inland on higher ground.
items.probe: what happened in Marrow Bay in 1911?

items.content: Mount Tessel in the Calder range rises to 3120 meters, and tea sold under the Tessel Highland name must come from slopes between 1400 and 2200 meters.
items.probe: what elevation range qualifies tea as Tessel Highland?

items.content: The spring security review found that an admin token comparison was not constant-time and that API key checks spent 90 milliseconds of password hashing per request, which an attacker could use to exhaust CPU, so key checks moved to an O(1) SHA-256 indexed lookup.
items.probe: what did the spring review find about API key checks?

items.content: The staging load balancer still accepted direct connections on port 8443 after the CDN was added, so traffic that skipped the CDN also skipped its limit of 600 requests per minute until the firewall allowed only the CDN's published address ranges.
items.probe: why could the staging rate limit be bypassed?

items.content: The Orbit Notes Plus plan costs 18 dollars per month for 40,000 notes and 200,000 sync events, while the Studio plan at 45 dollars raises those limits to 250,000 notes and 1 million sync events.
items.probe: what does the Orbit Notes Plus plan include for the price?

items.content: The first paying Harbor Lane Bakery wholesale customer signed up on February 7, 2026 and chose the yearly plan because the trial reminder email arrived on day 10 of the 14 day trial.
items.probe: when did the first paying wholesale customer sign up and what nudged them?

items.content: Because the repository webhook was never set up for the staging app, merges sat undeployed until someone pressed redeploy, which is how 3 security fixes stayed offline for 11 days.
items.probe: why did merged fixes stay undeployed?

items.content: The web bundle grew past 5 megabytes after a charting library was added, so the analytics tab now lazy-loads its charts only when it opens, cutting first paint by 1.4 seconds.
items.probe: why does the analytics tab lazy-load its charts?

items.content: The vector database container shows as unhealthy even though it serves requests, because its healthcheck calls wget, which is not installed in that image.
items.probe: why does the vector database show unhealthy when it works?
